examples.en: Guess who I ran into at the supermarket this afternoon!
examples.zh: 猜猜看我今天下午在超市遇到誰！
label: 例句

examples.en: Without any written records, scientists can only guess how the ancient temple was built.
examples.zh: 由於沒有任何文字記錄，科學家只能猜測這座古廟是如何建造的。
label: 例句

examples.en: Many tourists visit the lake in the mountains to enjoy the beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 許多遊客造訪山中的湖泊，欣賞美麗的風景。
label: 例句

examples.en: We had a picnic beside the lake last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末在湖邊野餐。
label: 例句

examples.en: A variety of frogs and fish live in the small pond near the school.
examples.zh: 學校附近的小池塘裡住著各種青蛙和魚。
label: 例句

examples.en: We fed the ducks by the pond in the park yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在公園的池塘邊餵鴨子。
label: 例句

examples.en: Students are asked to keep the classroom clean after lunch every day.
examples.zh: 學生們被要求每天午餐後保持教室乾淨。
label: 例句

examples.en: I need to clean my room before my parents come home.
examples.zh: 我得在爸媽回家前把房間打掃乾淨。
label: 例句

examples.en: Prices of vegetables jumped sharply after the typhoon damaged many crops.
examples.zh: 颱風損毀許多作物後，蔬菜價格急遽上漲。
label: 例句

examples.en: The dog jumped over the fence to chase the cat next door.
examples.zh: 那隻狗跳過柵欄去追隔壁的貓。
label: 例句

examples.en: A hammer is a basic tool that every household should have.
examples.zh: 鐵鎚是每個家庭都該具備的基本工具。
label: 例句

examples.en: The mechanic keeps his tools organized in a large metal box.
examples.zh: 這位技師把他的工具整齊地收在一個大鐵箱裡。
label: 例句

examples.en: Wearing a helmet keeps you safe when riding a bicycle.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車時戴安全帽能讓你保持安全。
label: 例句

examples.en: He locked the important documents in a safe at home.
examples.zh: 他把重要文件鎖在家裡的保險箱裡。
label: 例句

examples.en: Riding a motorcycle without a helmet can be extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 騎機車不戴安全帽可能非常危險。
label: 例句

examples.en: It is dangerous to swim in the river after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後在河裡游泳很危險。
label: 例句

examples.en: The little boy lost his favorite hat while playing in the wind.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩在風中玩耍時弄丟了他最喜歡的帽子。
label: 例句

examples.en: Remember to wear a hat when you go hiking under the strong summer sun.
examples.zh: 在強烈的夏日陽光下健行時，記得要戴帽子。
label: 例句

examples.en: Don't forget to put the cap back on the water bottle.
examples.zh: 別忘了把水瓶的蓋子蓋回去。
label: 例句

examples.en: He wore a baseball cap to shield his eyes from the bright sunlight.
examples.zh: 他戴著一頂棒球帽，以遮擋刺眼的陽光。
label: 例句

examples.en: These strawberries are so sweet and juicy!
examples.zh: 這些草莓好甜又多汁！
label: 例句

examples.en: This dessert is too sweet for most adults, though children seem to love it.
examples.zh: 這道甜點對大多數成人來說太甜了，不過孩子們似乎很愛。
label: 例句

examples.en: My uncle works at a shoe factory near the harbor.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在港口附近的一家製鞋工廠工作。
label: 例句

examples.en: Many workers lost their jobs when the factory closed down.
examples.zh: 工廠倒閉後，許多工人失去了工作。
label: 例句

examples.en: Many students are afraid of making mistakes when speaking English in public.
examples.zh: 許多學生害怕在公開場合說英文時會犯錯。
label: 例句

examples.en: I'm afraid I can't come to your party tonight.
examples.zh: 恐怕我今晚沒辦法參加你的派對了。
label: 例句

examples.en: Please take your seat before the concert begins.
examples.zh: 請在音樂會開始前入座。
label: 例句

examples.en: I booked a window seat for the flight to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我訂了一個飛往東京班機的靠窗座位。
label: 例句

examples.en: He rowed the boat gently across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 他輕輕划著船，穿過寧靜的湖面。
label: 例句

examples.en: The students sat in a row waiting for the school bus to arrive.
examples.zh: 學生們排成一列坐著，等校車來。
label: 例句

examples.en: My brother doesn't eat meat, so he always orders a vegetable dish.
examples.zh: 我哥哥不吃肉，所以他總是點蔬菜料理。
label: 例句

examples.en: Many people are eating less red meat because they want to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 許多人為了保持健康而減少食用紅肉。
label: 例句

examples.en: Taiwanese beef noodle soup is popular with tourists from all over the world.
examples.zh: 台灣牛肉麵深受來自世界各地遊客的喜愛。
label: 例句

examples.en: My mother cooked beef and vegetables for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我媽媽今晚煮了牛肉和蔬菜當晚餐。
label: 例句

examples.en: My doctor told me to eat less salt to protect my heart.
examples.zh: 醫生要我少吃鹽以保護心臟。
label: 例句

examples.en: Could you pass the salt? This soup tastes a bit bland without it.
examples.zh: 你可以把鹽遞給我嗎？這碗湯少了鹽味道有點淡。
label: 例句

examples.en: She added two spoons of sugar to her coffee every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都在咖啡裡加兩匙糖。
label: 例句

examples.en: Could you pass me the sugar? I want to make some tea.
examples.zh: 可以把糖遞給我嗎?我想泡杯茶。
label: 例句

examples.en: It's easy to make a mistake when you are in a hurry.
examples.zh: 匆忙的時候很容易犯錯。
label: 例句

examples.en: She mistook the stranger for her old classmate at the station.
examples.zh: 她在車站把那個陌生人誤認成她的老同學。
label: 例句

examples.en: My little brother loves watching magic shows on TV.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很愛看電視上的魔術表演。
label: 例句

examples.en: In the fairy tale, the old wizard used magic to turn a pumpkin into a golden carriage.
examples.zh: 在童話故事裡，年老的巫師用魔法把南瓜變成金色的馬車。
label: 例句

examples.en: I have known my best friend since we were in elementary school.
examples.zh: 我從小學就認識我最好的朋友了。
label: 例句

examples.en: Everyone should know how to protect the environment for future generations.
examples.zh: 每個人都應該知道如何為後代保護環境。
label: 例句

examples.en: She has a good knowledge of French cooking.
examples.zh: 她對法國料理很有研究。
label: 例句

examples.en: Reading widely can broaden your knowledge of the world.
examples.zh: 廣泛閱讀能拓展你對世界的認識。
label: 例句

examples.en: We ran out of milk, so I went to the supermarket after school.
examples.zh: 我們的牛奶用完了，所以我放學後去了超市。
label: 例句

examples.en: My mother goes to the supermarket every Saturday morning to buy groceries.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每個星期六早上都會去超市採買生活雜貨。
label: 例句

examples.en: Every summer, my family visits my grandparents in Tainan.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，我家人都會去台南拜訪祖父母。
label: 例句

examples.en: We visited the National Palace Museum last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末參觀了故宮博物院。
label: 例句

examples.en: We plan to visit the science museum this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們打算這個週末去參觀科學博物館。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 參觀

examples.en: We had a visitor from Japan staying with us last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末有一位來自日本的訪客和我們住在一起。
label: 例句

examples.en: The museum welcomes thousands of visitors from around the world every year.
examples.zh: 這間博物館每年歡迎來自世界各地數以千計的遊客。
label: 例句

examples.en: Doctors need to know a patient's blood type before performing surgery.
examples.zh: 醫生在動手術前需要知道病患的血型。
label: 例句

examples.en: She typed the report quickly and sent it to her manager before noon.
examples.zh: 她很快地把報告打好，並在中午前傳給了經理。
label: 例句

examples.en: The office hired a cleaner to work every evening.
examples.zh: 這間辦公室僱用了一位清潔工每晚工作。
label: 例句

examples.en: This cleaner works well on kitchen windows.
examples.zh: 這種清潔劑對廚房窗戶的效果很好。
label: 例句

examples.en: The kids were hopping around the playground, laughing loudly.
examples.zh: 孩子們在遊樂場裡蹦蹦跳跳，笑得很大聲。
label: 例句

examples.en: The rabbit hopped across the yard and disappeared into the bushes.
examples.zh: 兔子跳過院子，消失在灌木叢中。
label: 例句

examples.en: For safety reasons, all passengers must fasten their seat belts before the plane takes off.
examples.zh: 基於安全考量，所有乘客在飛機起飛前都必須繫好安全帶。
label: 例句

examples.en: The construction workers wore helmets and vests to ensure their safety on the job site.
examples.zh: 工地工人戴上安全帽並穿上背心，以確保工作時的安全。
label: 例句

examples.en: Wearing a seat belt can save your life in a serious car accident.
examples.zh: 在嚴重的車禍中，繫上安全帶可以挽救你的性命。
label: 例句

examples.en: She saves a little money every month to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 她每個月存一點錢，為的是買一台新筆電。
label: 例句

examples.en: Smoking is a serious danger to your health.
examples.zh: 吸菸對你的健康是一大嚴重危害。
label: 例句

examples.en: Climbers should be aware of the danger of sudden weather changes in the mountains.
examples.zh: 登山者應該留意山區天氣驟變的危險。
label: 例句

examples.en: Scientists warn that these chemicals are harmful to the environment.
examples.zh: 科學家警告，這些化學物質對環境有害。
label: 例句

examples.en: Too much sugar can be harmful to your teeth.
examples.zh: 攝取太多糖分可能對你的牙齒有害。
label: 例句

examples.en: Riding a scooter without a helmet is risky, even for a short trip.
examples.zh: 就算只是短程，不戴安全帽騎機車也很危險。
label: 例句

examples.en: Investing all your savings in one company's stock is too risky for most beginners.
examples.zh: 把所有積蓄都投資在同一家公司的股票，對大多數新手來說太冒險了。
label: 例句

examples.en: Climbing that cliff without a rope is far too risky.
examples.zh: 沒有繩子就爬那面峭壁太危險了。
label: 例句
原標籤：adj. · 危險的、有風險的（考點：可能導致損失或受傷）

examples.en: My grandmother grows many plants in her small garden.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在她的小花園裡種了很多植物。
label: 例句

examples.en: Volunteers planted hundreds of trees along the river to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 志工沿著河岸種植了數百棵樹以保護環境。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 種植

examples.en: Daniel loves this song so much that he sings it all the time.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾太愛這首歌了，所以一直在唱。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 喜愛

examples.en: Janice loves reading novels in bed before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 珍妮絲睡前很愛窩在床上看小說。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 喜愛

examples.en: Janice loves to read novels in bed before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 珍妮絲睡前很愛窩在床上看小說。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 喜愛

examples.en: When Jack met Rose, it was love at first sight.
examples.zh: 傑克遇見蘿絲時，對她一見鍾情。
label: 例句
原標籤：n. · 愛情（love at first sight：一見鍾情）

examples.en: Jasper fell in love with Clara two years ago.
examples.zh: 賈斯柏 2 年前與克萊拉相戀。
label: 例句
原標籤：n. · 愛情（fall in love with：愛上）

examples.en: Many teenagers love to spend their weekends chatting with friends online.
examples.zh: 許多青少年喜歡在週末花時間跟朋友線上聊天。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 喜愛；喜歡

examples.en: I fell in love with the city the first time I visited it.
examples.zh: 我第一次造訪這座城市就愛上它了。
label: 例句

examples.en: Vicky's love for her husband grew over the years.
examples.zh: 多年來，薇琪對老公的愛越來越深。
label: 例句
原標籤：n. · 愛；愛情

examples.en: This soup is a little too salty for me.
examples.zh: 這碗湯對我來說有點太鹹了。
label: 例句

examples.en: Doctors warn that eating too many salty foods can raise blood pressure.
examples.zh: 醫生警告，吃太多鹹的食物會使血壓升高。
label: 例句

examples.en: People used salt to preserve meat before refrigerators were invented.
examples.zh: 在冰箱發明之前，人們用鹽來保存肉類。
label: 例句

examples.en: The government built a museum to preserve the town's history.
examples.zh: 政府建了一座博物館來保存這座小鎮的歷史。
label: 例句

examples.en: Walking through the snow at night felt truly magical to us.
examples.zh: 在夜裡走過雪地讓我們感覺真的很奇幻。
label: 例句

examples.en: The fireworks created a magical atmosphere on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 煙火在跨年夜營造出奇幻的氣氛。
label: 例句

examples.en: The company hopes to enter the Southeast Asian market next year.
examples.zh: 公司希望明年進入東南亞市場。
label: 例句
原標籤：n. · 市場

examples.en: They wanted to market the product for people aged twenty to thirty.
examples.zh: 他們想要將這項產品銷售給 20 到 30 歲的人。
label: 例句
原標籤：v. · 行銷；推銷

examples.en: This market is open every morning until noon.
examples.zh: 這個市場每天從早上營業到中午。
label: 例句
原標籤：n. · 市場

examples.en: This new product will soon be on the market.
examples.zh: 這個新產品很快就會上市。
label: 例句
原標籤：n. · 市場（on the market：上市）

examples.en: The company plans to market its new phone to young students.
examples.zh: 這家公司打算向年輕學生推銷新手機。
label: 例句

examples.en: Taiwan's night markets are popular with both locals and tourists.
examples.zh: 台灣的夜市深受當地人與觀光客的喜愛。
label: 例句

examples.en: Please write your address clearly on the envelope.
examples.zh: 請把你的住址清楚地寫在信封上。
label: 例句

examples.en: The government has promised to address the problem of air pollution.
examples.zh: 政府承諾要處理空氣污染的問題。
label: 例句

examples.en: Every guest at the wedding banquet received a small gift as a token of thanks.
examples.zh: 婚宴上的每位來賓都收到一份小禮物作為謝禮。
label: 例句

examples.en: The hotel offers free breakfast to every guest who stays for more than two nights.
examples.zh: 這間飯店為住宿超過兩晚的房客提供免費早餐。
label: 例句

examples.en: The old temple has become a popular spot for tourists.
examples.zh: 這座古老的寺廟已成為觀光客喜愛的熱門景點。
label: 例句

examples.en: Every summer, thousands of tourists visit this island to enjoy its beautiful beaches.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，成千上萬的觀光客造訪這座島嶼，享受美麗的海灘。
label: 例句

examples.en: Being shy in front of strangers is typical of my little sister.
examples.zh: 在陌生人面前害羞是我妹妹的典型表現。
label: 例句

examples.en: Rice and vegetables are a typical breakfast in many Asian countries.
examples.zh: 米飯和蔬菜是許多亞洲國家典型的早餐。
label: 例句

examples.en: It is important to be kind to classmates who are having a hard time.
examples.zh: 對正經歷困難的同學友善是很重要的。
label: 例句

examples.en: What kind of music do you usually listen to on weekends?
examples.zh: 你週末平常都聽哪種音樂？
label: 例句

examples.en: What sort of music do you usually listen to on the way to school?
examples.zh: 你上學途中通常聽哪種音樂？
label: 例句

examples.en: He spent the afternoon sorting out his old photos and letters.
examples.zh: 他花了一個下午整理他的舊照片和信件。
label: 例句
